Open GA4: MCM — 404 Pages · Tabs: All historical 404s (52 paths / 444 views), Still 404 — all 50 paths (50 / 378), and Working now — exact paths (2 / 66). GA status groups are a manual November 1 snapshot; they do not query live HTTP status.

Scope, trailing-slash correction & reading guide

Also checked all 230 published WordPress page/post URLs and their server-rendered hyperlinks, the current page/post inventory including drafts, and all 422 media records. This is a complete inventory of the supplied GA list, not of every URL ever requested or discovered by Google. Search Console’s 100,945 missing URLs and the rolling WordPress logs are separate populations.

Correction from the earlier sample: trailing-slash variants were previously grouped together. The exact Accelerator 2021 and workflow-design paths in GA have no trailing slash and return 404; their slash-ending versions return 200. The corrected totals are 378 + 66 = 444. Current source hyperlinks are checked separately so working variants are not called broken. “Working now” does not establish when a repair happened.

Source-page links below open normal pages containing the relevant hyperlink. A red screenshot box marks the actual clickable link. Where no source is found, the inventory says so instead of inventing one. Historical GA counts cannot be attributed to the listed current sources without referrer evidence.

Matching GA: GA-xx is a fixed inventory ID, not a table row. Each entry lists its row in All, Still 404, and Working. Positions were read from the saved GA tabs with Views descending for August 3–October 31, 2026. Sorting, date changes, or added filters change GA row numbers; the exact URL is the reliable match.
